title: Transfer condition is inverted
evidence: if balance(src) <= amount lets the transfer proceed only when the balance is too LOW; the comparison is backwards and should be >= amount.
recommendation: use balance(src) >= amount so a transfer needs sufficient funds.

title: Database connection leaked
evidence: conn = db.connect() is never closed after conn.close() was removed; the connection leaks on every call (no context manager).
recommendation: close conn in a finally block or use a with-context manager.
